# Editorial proposal maker

Read `design.md`, discover Studio's live generation schema, presets, templates,
and assets, then submit one bounded `propose_document_generation` request.
Treat visual references as analysis unless Studio returns an approved asset ID.
Use template mode when its page structure fits; otherwise compile a blank plan.
Inspect the candidate in Review and stop before human approval. One explicit
replacement is allowed when the candidate has a material defect.
